checks.text: The page shows the heading "Weekly Planner" and a week view displaying the days "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun".

Clicking the button "Add event" opens a dialog. Filling the field labelled "Title" with "Team Sync", the field labelled "Day" with "Tue", and the field labelled "Time" with "10:00", then clicking "Save" adds an event card on the Tue column containing "Team Sync" and "10:00".

Clicking the button "Add task" in the checklist panel, typing "Review PR" in the input labelled "New task", and pressing Enter adds a checkable item "Review PR" to the checklist. The progress indicator shows "1 of 1".
Clicking the checkbox next to "Review PR" marks it complete. The progress indicator updates to "1 of 1 done" and the item text is struck through.
Clicking the tab "Month" switches the view to a month grid. The current month name is displayed, and the event "Team Sync" appears in the cell for the correct date.
Clicking the button "Export ICS" copies an ICS string to the clipboard. The string contains "BEGIN:VEVENT", "SUMMARY:Team Sync", and "END:VEVENT".
Clicking the button "Delete Team Sync" on the event card removes it from the Tue column. The week view no longer shows "Team Sync".
Clicking the button "Delete Review PR" on the checklist item removes it. The checklist shows "No tasks yet" and the progress indicator is hidden.
Reload keeps the event "Team Sync" on Tue at 10:00 and the checklist item "Review PR" in its unchecked state.
